name: What is embodied energy in building materials?

mainEntity.name: What is embodied energy in building materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Embodied energy refers to the total energy consumed to produce a material, from raw material extraction and manufacturing to transport and installation. Minimizing embodied energy is a key aspect of sustainable building. Choosing locally sourced materials or those with recycled content can significantly reduce this impact. Hometelligent Inc. considers the embodied energy of materials as a decision factor when recommending options for projects in regions like Berkeley and Richmond, aiming to lower the overall environmental footprint of construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Embodied energy is the total energy consumed to produce a material, from extraction to installation, and minimizing it is key to sustainability.
